jail._comment: Jail zones and sentences (server\jail.js). struggle._comment: Breaking free of bound hands with /struggle (server\struggle.js): strikes landed in a row, band half-width in percent of the bar (watchedBand while anyone lawful other than the captor is within watchMeters, who is told; the captor is always told and never narrows it), sweepMs for the first crossing of the bar, multiplied by speedUp after each landed strike down to minSweepMs, seconds per attempt, one miss fails. winChance is the chance a clean round frees the captive, the most a scripted client can reach. cooldownMinutes between attempts, kept on the character. nearbyMeters hear about a break-out. whileCarried false refuses a carried captive. The escape grace before recapture is captureEscapeGraceMs in server-settings.json (20000 by default).
struggle._clientJudged: Jake, 2026-09-30: the labour widget that draws /struggle may report its own verdict and the server accepts it, keeping only checks latency cannot fail (nonce, one report, the pull list's range, flood, cooldown, early, overtime, stall and precise checks, no win sooner than the round's fastest, the cooldown and winChance). An old widget is judged from its pulls without the late and future checks. expireMs cleans up a round nobody reports. replayCheck: 'log' lets a claimed win its pulls do not bear out stand with a STRUGGLE-MISMATCH audit line, 'refuse' refuses it. ROLLBACK: commit clientJudged false to this file on origin/server and ship it (a release, or dev-server.sh deploy-gameplay --hotfix); today's judging (lagGraceMs refuses late reports) comes back for every client. Not as a live-only edit: every release and hotfix copies this file over the live one and keeps only admins, so a live edit lasts only until the next deploy.
struggle._pick: Read the rope (Nate, 4 Oct: no timing mini-games). A UI that says dbo:uiCaps pickRound (front 0.3.77+) gets a round with no sweep: every pull shows spots on the rope (watchedSpots while someone lawful watches, aloneSpots on a rope left unattended), one where it gives with the clearest cue (cue; decoys at most decoy, watchedDecoy or aloneDecoy); one wrong pull and the bonds hold. seconds bounds the whole round. Pulls, cooldowns, watchers and winChance are unchanged. Every other UI keeps the timing round. ROLLBACK: pick.enabled false. Hot reload.

ropeUnattended._comment: A rope captive left unattended (server\rope.js): the gap, the chance a clean round frees them and the wait between tries, in place of band, winChance and cooldownMinutes above. The wait counts from the start of the last try. With the captor near, a rope captive plays the round above.

rope._comment: Tying someone up without authority (server\rope.js with captureSystem.ts; Nate, 2026-09-30). item: the Rope a binding uses, one per knot. A player carrying one ties a downed player at once, or a conscious one who says yes; never on sight. Unattended: the captor more than unattendedMeters away, in another cell or down, for unattendedAfterSeconds in a row. Unattended time adds up and pauses while the captor is back; the captive is warned at warnMinutes and the rope slips off at slipMinutes. cutFree: anyone else standing within cutReach units cuts a rope captive free in cutSeconds, broken if either moves more than cutMoveUnits (rope only, never shackles). Animations are Helgen's (MQ101, where Hadvar or Ralof cuts the player's binds), sent with Debug.SendAnimationEvent on that player; empty plays nothing: cutFreeIdle on the rescuer as the cut starts, cutFreeStop when a cut breaks, cutFreeCaptiveIdle on the captive at the end while still bound, then the release cutFreeReleaseMs later, tieIdle on the captor at the knot. If the player's graph lacks them, IdleLockPick or IdleSearchingTable; never a paired pa_ idle. The refusal hold and the escape grace are ropeRefusalHoldMs and ropeEscapeGraceMs in server-settings.json (2 min and 60 s by default).

They also leave the held list. keepShouts [] takes off the all-shouts grant; none leaves shouts alone. offline 'apply' trims a character who is offline on the saved form, 'wait' waits until they have been online trimSettleMs. profile must match the character. The seven jake-1017-trim-<actor> entries (Jake, 17 Oct ~03:25Z: take off every spell Give all spells gave, since the grants froze the server; each read of a 331-spell list held the loop about 4.5 s): one for each character that still holds a Give all spells grant, ff001473 (profile 47), ff0005e7 and ff001a60 (profile 2), ff0013ec (profile 4), ff001585 (profile 3), ff000019 and ff001bbb (profile 6), 1043 removals in all. keepSpells is the learned list of the last world backup before the character's first grant (none for a character made after it), every learned spell on neither Give all list (the DBO_Skill mastery abilities) and the spellbook, prepared and audit-logged learns; removeSpells is the rest of the learned list plus the suspended spells a grant added that spells.hold holds (da746:Skyrim.esm and 8dcec:Druadach.esm for ff001473, da746:Skyrim.esm for ff001585), every one on the admin panel's Give all spells list (admin-powers.json, the 254 tome spells since 16 Oct, which hold the 133 given before). After the trims the learned lists are 84 (ff001473, from 331), 25, 80, 11, 0, 10 and 6. No keepShouts: the Give all shouts grants stay, since shouts live only in the client and never slow the server. The runs share one timer, one batch of 20 a second in all (55 batches). ROLLBACK: the removed list is kept on each character (private.dboSpellTrims) and in the audit; give spells back with the admin panel or Actor.AddSpell only once the engine fix is live, since all of them back is the freeze again.

schools._comment: Schools of magic (server\schools.js, Swag's rework, Nate 2026-09-30). A mage chooses a primary school from `schools` (K, Arcane Arts page, or at a Study Magic shelf); the rest lock until Arcane Arts reaches secondaryAtLevel, when one secondary may be chosen, starting at secondaryStartLevel. Each school is a 0-100 meter on the Wheel's curve (Novice 1, Apprentice 25, Adept 50, Expert 75, Master 90) and a tome of it is read only up to its rank. Casting an active school's spell adds castUnits (repeats worth less), at most castDailyUnits a school a day. study: a ref in `refs` (the Synod Conclave's seven bookcases) or a base with editor id `edid` (Nate's StudyMagic activator, DLE v8: the Conclave, Frostcrag Spire, the College of Winterhold) opens Study Magic: unitsPerTick every tickSeconds to the primary while the reader stays within moveLimitMeters, minutesPerWindow in any rolling windowHours, closed once a spell learned through Arcane Arts is in the spellbook. classes: a Class Lectern (base editor id `edid`: Nate's ClassLectern activator in DLE v7, two boxes per lectern at the Synod, Frostcrag Spire and the Hall of the Elements, listed in `lecterns`; boxes within sameLecternUnits are one lectern); a teacher holding a teacherRoles rank (leader or officer; Nate 13 Oct) in one of teacherGuilds (or on the staff list via /classteacher, only when requireList), at teacherMinRank (3 = Expert) in the school, sets a class by one known spell; students sign up in the first joinMinutes; after `minutes` the teacher ends it and each student in the classroom (the lectern's interior cell, or radiusMeters outdoors) gets units x scale[student rank][class rank]; graceMinutes away cancels (teacher) or drops (student); cooldowns teacherCooldownMinutes after a finished class, studentCooldownHours between paid classes. Study and classes also credit Arcane Arts through masterySystem's cast credit (wheel), inside the Wheel's hourly and daily limits. requireClient: the gate and panels only for clients whose UI reports the 'schools' capability. Off until the client pack with the school meters and the two panels is out.

durability._comment: Weapon and armour wear (server\durability.js, Nate 19 Oct). Tiers tierNames (Intact, Worn, Damaged, Broken) show in the item's name in the inventory; Worn and Damaged cost effectMult of the piece's damage or armour rating, Broken cannot be worn. Wear points a tier: pointsPerTier.weapon / .armor; a landed blow wears the weapon by hitPoints, a hit taken one worn armour piece (in turn) by hitPoints, a blocked hit the shield by blockPoints, a death every worn piece a whole tier. Repair at a sharpening wheel (wheelKeywords, weapons) or an armorer's bench (benchKeywords, armour): the smith's Blacksmith craft tier must reach the piece's family tier (smithing.json); each tier repaired costs feePerTier of the piece's base value (at least feeMin) and that gold is destroyed; a Broken piece also takes its recipe's materials (salvage.json). rite._comment: The rite mini-game (Blood Fever, Hircine's Hunt, Molag Bal's Embrace, the Great Hunt). Merged key by key with supernatural.js RITE_DEFAULTS, so a partial block like this one keeps rounds, need and leadMs.
rite._clientJudged: Jake, 2026-09-30: about half the rite misses of the players we could measure came from lag. A client whose UI names riteJudge (the next client cut) judges each strike at the frame on screen with graceMs and reports it with its own times; the server checks the round (once only), that the press fits the round on the widget's clock and that the report did not arrive sooner than the round could be played, and never reads when it arrived. Today's widgets send no time, so they are still judged by arrival, now with one continuous window (lateWindowMs back, earlyWindowMs ahead) and legacyExtraMs more on the round's timer. That holds only up to about 400 ms of round trip with no packet lost (review LAT-2, 2026-10-01: at 1 s, 9 in 100 centre-line Embraces survived), so legacyDeadly 'safe' puts no such client through a rite that kills: Molag Bal's Embrace and the Great Hunt are declined with a line about the update, and a fever rite it loses breaks the fever without killing (the carrier lives, not turned). 'allow' lets the arrival-judged rites kill as before. replayCheck: 'log' lets a claimed hit the press time does not bear out stand with a RITE-MISMATCH audit line, 'refuse' scores the replay. ROLLBACK: commit clientJudged false to this file on origin/server and ship it (a release, or dev-server.sh deploy-gameplay --hotfix); the three-sample arrival check and the 7.7 s timer come back for every client, and legacyDeadly no longer applies (today's rite). Not as a live-only edit: every release and hotfix copies this file over the live one and keeps only admins, so a live edit lasts only until the next deploy.

Whatever was in your blood is gone.", is audited (RITE ... cured, no death), kills nobody (the old fever rite killed) and is never offered again. Only a client that judges its own strikes (riteJudge) gets the trial; one judged by when its strikes arrive turns with no trial, so lag never decides it. A rite never touched, or a disconnect while even or ahead, is still not a failure and comes back on a later tick. rounds 5 -> 7, needFever 3 -> 5, needVoluntary 4 -> 6 (Molag Bal's Embrace and the Great Hunt share the rounds): the misses allowed stay 2 and 1, so it is harder by length and need, not by timing; the timing rite's rounds 6 and 7 are as fast and as narrow as its round 5 (supernatural.js newRound); the pick rite's are in _pickHarder. Measured on live (5-25 Oct): 6 fever rites survived and 7 failed (most at 0/5, before the untouched-rite fixes), Molag Bal's Embrace 44 survived and 17 failed, the Great Hunt 62 and 9; 18-25 Oct 77 Sanguinare and 9 Sanies infections, 9 fevers peaked. The lag windows (graceMs, lateWindowMs, earlyWindowMs, legacyExtraMs) are untouched. A rite for a UI that says dbo:uiCaps riteJudge and pickRound (front 0.3.77+) has no marker: each round shows spotsByRound marks on the strip (a pulse of the slowing heart for the Blood Fever and the Embrace, a track of the prey for Hircine's Hunt and the Great Hunt), one clearest (cueByRound) and the others fainter (decoyByRound); later rounds have more marks and closer decoys, as the zone narrows today. Picking the clearest is a hit; another is a miss; a round unpicked for roundSeconds is a miss, and a rite never touched is abandoned as before. Rounds, needs, deaths, the permadeath roll and the shrine waits are unchanged. Every other UI keeps the timing rite. ROLLBACK: pick.enabled false. Hot reload.

npcPowerHits._comment: How hard a creature's or NPC's power attack lands on a player (gamemode.js npcPowerHitMult). The server's damage formula doubles every power attack flat, on top of the NPC-on-player x2 in server-settings, ignoring the attack's own multiplier (1.0 for most creature power attacks), so a boar bit a new character for half their health (Purr, 30 Sep). 0.5 undoes that flat x2; 1 changes nothing. Players' own power attacks and hits on NPCs are never touched. Hot reload.

hostCooldown._comment: hostcooldown.js: an NPC stays with its live host this long after it changes hands (handoverMs) or after any hit it gives or takes (fightMs). Nate, 9 Oct: a minotaur fighting him moved to the next player who hit it and stopped attacking; the 5 s default let it change hands between swings. fightMaxMs (unset = off) caps a fight's hold at so long from its first blow or from a hand-over during it; it must be well above fightMs (1e12 = off), or blows stop extending the hold and the mid-fight swap comes back.

A seat is the leader rank of any faction (guild, college, secret, allegiance, faith, cult, house, pack, clan, charter, rising), an officer rank of one (officerRoles, guild-defs.json role names), or a court office in courtSeats or rulerRanks. A pack's Alpha counts as a leader seat, as before. officers false goes back to leaders and rulers only. perAccount true holds the rule across all characters of one account. Every seating, promotion and court appointment asks __dboLeadershipRefusal (appointCheck and seatOfficial in gamemode.js; setMember, setRankOf, /faction leader, charters, rank edits in guilds.js). An owner opens a property as a business; owner and staff set the inn's bed rent (minRent..maxRent), keep a logbook and put chests up for rent (up to maxChestPrice a day; chestGraceHours to empty after the rent ends). Each hold's rent tax is set by taxRanks, 0..maxTax; until then rest.holdShare stands.

combat._comment: Skill-based fights (combat.js, COMBAT_DESIGN.md), player targets only, needs the C++ hit flags. A blocked blow lets weaponChip (shieldChip with a shield) through, less chipPerDefenseTier per Defense rank; the blocker pays the rest in stamina (x shieldStaminaMult with a shield, x powerIntoShieldStaminaMult more for a power attack into a shield). Unblocked power attacks stagger; a weapon-skill rank of powerStaggerThroughWeaponBlockRank staggers through a weapon block. A bash deals bashDamageMult of the weapon and staggers unless the target's Defense rank is bashStaggerResistRank or more (3 = Expert). One stagger per target every staggerCooldownSeconds.

martialArts._comment: Martial Arts (martial.js; the skill id stays unarmed). staminaDamage: every melee blow (fists and weapons, not bows or spells, NPCs' too) is full at fullAt of the attacker's stamina or more and falls linearly to minMult at none. fists.drainByTier: stamina points a landed fist takes from its target by the attacker's Martial Arts rank (untrainedDrain without the skill), x powerDrainMult for a power attack; armorExtra: how much more the target's armour counts against fists; powerDisarm: a landed unarmed power attack unequips a player's weapons (combat.js disarm cooldown), from powerDisarmMinRank. staves.armorPierce: the share of the armour's reduction a staff ignores. Fist tier damage is mastery.damage.fistByTier; staves use byTier.

gearFortify._comment: Worn Fortify One-handed, Two-handed and Archery enchantments (gamemode.js gearAttackMult; Nate 18 Oct, toned down): each point adds perPoint to that weapon's blows (vanilla gives 0.01), all worn gear together at most cap. Players only.

gearEnchantments._comment: Enchantments the server judges (gearench.js; enchantment audit, Nate 20 Oct). The client engine applies enchantments only to its own copy of the world and the server judges every hit, so each part re-implements one kind; the 20 Oct plugin nerf already halved most magnitudes. Every part has its own enabled.

weaponHits._comment: An enchanted weapon (not a staff) on a landed, unblocked blow: elemental and chaos damage resisted like a spell, absorb, stamina and magicka damage, paralysis, frost slow, Mehrunes Razor, the Ebony Blade (its lowest tier: the kill count is not readable), Dawnbreaker. A player copy needs a hit worth of charge (the client drains it, craftedExtras keeps it). Skipped for an NPC hitting the player who hosts it: that engine applied it already. damageMult scales the points; minHealth: an enchantment never lands the killing blow; assumedMaxMagicka: the pool magicka points come off (the server cannot read maximum magicka). Conditions: GetRandomPercent, HasKeyword and GetIsID run here, a tier the server cannot tell counts as its lowest, anything else leaves the effect out.

pvp._comment: PvP balance (Nate 20 Oct: balance everything with PvP in mind; enchantments are a garnish on skill: mastery tiers +35/+65/+100%, Defense x1.25..x3.5, a naked player 150 health). On a PLAYER target an enchantment deals, absorbs and drains pvpMult of its points (NPCs in full). A player is paralysed at most pvpParalysisMaxSeconds by a weapon or staff, then immune to every paralysis for pvpParalysisImmuneSeconds; never while downed or held. One log line per attacker each logEverySeconds for an enchanted hit on a player. Fear, calm and frenzy never touch players (the engine and the C++ apply them to NPCs only).

resist._comment: Worn Resist Fire, Frost, Shock, Magic and Poison on the target side of every hit they resist (Resist Magic: any spell, staff or enchantment). The gear share is at most gearResistCap a resistance; race, potion, gear and blessing together never take more than racial.reductionCap off a hit.

fortifyHealth._comment: Worn Fortify Health on a player counts as health (a stat, not a resistance): a hit lands as on a pool that much larger, like a Fortify Health potion (gamemode.js potionTakenMult), outside the reduction cap. The gear extra is at most gearHealthCap points.

regen._comment: Worn Heal, Magicka and Stamina Rate enchantments on a player (the server crops a client report to its own rates, CropRegeneration.cpp, so they did nothing). prayer.js prayerBlessingRegen adds them in the units it adds a blessing (a Rate effect its magnitude to the rate, a RateMult effect its magnitude % of the race rate), the gear share at most gearRegenCap of the bar base rate; they add to a blessing, and racial.js regeneration is its own factor beside both.

staffRiders._comment: A staff (ENCH) on a PLAYER: its paralysis (gamemode.js spellHitHook, dboParalyse, at most pvp.pvpParalysisMaxSeconds then the immunity window), frost slow (dboStatus), stamina and magicka damage at pvp.pvpMult, and while server-settings spellSync.absorb is false the caster gets back what an absorb staff took. Fear, calm, frenzy, rally and turn undead never touch players. NPC targets are the fork (ActionListener riders); npcServerHold: true makes the gameplay hold a paralysed NPC too, for when the fork holds staves (until then only where the caster hosts the NPC).

block._comment: Worn Fortify Block on a player: a blocked blow lets perPoint a point less through (combat.js chip, with a Fortify Block potion at most all of it), at most cap.

heavyArmor._comment: Worn Fortify Heavy Armor on a player: worn heavy pieces count perPoint a point more armour in the Defense path (gamemode.js defenseDamageMult, the Flesh spells too), at most cap.

lightArmor._comment: Worn Fortify Light Armor: the same for light pieces.

unarmed._comment: Worn Fortify Unarmed: fists land harder through gearAttackMult, on gearFortify perPoint and cap, so fists and weapons stay even.

pickpocket._comment: Worn Fortify Pickpocket: perPoint a point more chance in pickpocket.js (still within its minChance and maxChance), at most cap.

spellbreaker._comment: Spellbreaker (DA13SpellBreakerEnch: WardPower 50 while IsBlocking; UESP: protects against spells for up to 50 points): while its wearer blocks, a spell from within frontDegrees of the front loses up to the ward points left; spent, the ward breaks; raised again after a lowered shield or rearmSeconds without a spell, it holds a fresh 50. Inside the reduction cap like a racial ward. The server cannot tell an area spell, so a Fireball from the front is warded too.

uniques._comment: Scripted uniques the engine runs by script, on the server: Mehrunes Razor (DA07MehrunesRazorMagicEffectScript: RandomInt(0, 100) <= 1, so 2 in 101) kills an NPC outright, never a player, companion, boss, essential, protected or unique NPC; Dawnbreaker (GetRandomPercent <= 25 on undead) marks for markSeconds and the marked undead dying bursts DA09DawnbreakerBaneOfUndeadSpell fire 25 on the undead within 80 ft (feetToUnits), vampire players at pvp.pvpMult (its turn undead and stagger need the fork); the Shrouded Gloves (Backstab, UESP: double sneak attack damage with one-handed weapons) multiply a one-handed sneak attack by mult. The Ebony Blade absorb counts its lowest tier (10), as its kill count is not readable server-side.

weaponMaterials._comment: Extra damage by the weapon's material keyword (editor id), on top of its base damage, for hits by players (playersOnly) in every fight. Vanilla puts Daedric (sword 14) and Dragonbone (15) one point apart; with this Dragonbone hits about 16% harder than Daedric and a Daedric sword about 2.4x an Iron one. Keywords from Skyrim.esm, Dawnguard (DLC1) and Dragonborn (DLC2), and Saints & Seducers' Madness (as Daedric), and ArmorMaterialDragonplate, which Immersive Weapons puts on its Dragonsteel weapons (as Dragonbone; only weapons read this list), so tier 5 always out-hits tier 4 (Nate, 2026-09-30; tools/recipes/t4_below_t5.py). Amber (as Glass, 0.13) is held until the PC ladder run's plugin lowers its stats: with the bonus on today's records an Amber sword (16.95) out-hits a Daedric one (16.80) (Worker D's review); a weapon without one of these gets nothing.

armorMaterials._comment: Rating an armor material counts for, by slot, when higher than its records give (gamemode.js armorPieceOf). The engine keeps the record's rating; the server counts this one where Defense and tempering count (the hit's armor reduction) and shows it in the inventory. Nate, 2026-09-29: Dragonbone and Dragonscale above Ebony. Dragonplate (Update.esm) already beats Ebony piece for piece (46/17/17/22/34 against 43/16/16/21/32); Dragonscale (41/12/12/17/29, light) now counts one above Ebony on every piece. Daedric stays on top (49/18/18/23/36).

pickpocket._comment: Sneak + X on a player (pickpocket.js). chance: chanceUntrained, or chanceByTier by Lockpicking tier, + behindBonus (outside a behindConeDegrees cone of the face), - weaponDrawnPenalty, within min/maxChance. A success takes goldShareByTier of the coin (at most goldMax) or one pocket item (never a worn copy, never a key); the victim notices noticeAfterSeconds later. Failure warns the victim at once. Lockpicking credit for creditMinGold or an item, never a party member, creditsPerHour at most. exclude: item descs never taken.

Kept: the nonce, the order's shape, the words, the cooldowns and daily caps, no right reading faster than minMsPerWord a word. An old widget (no timings) is judged by the server's deadline plus legacyGraceMs instead of graceMs. roundTimeoutMinutes sweeps a round nobody answered, with the lost round's cooldown. ROLLBACK: commit clientJudged false to this file on origin/server and ship it (a release, or dev-server.sh deploy-gameplay --hotfix); the server's deadline plus graceMs decides again for every client. Older widgets keep the per-try path, which already judges on the widget's clock. ROLLBACK: commit clientJudged false to this file on origin/server and ship it (a release, or dev-server.sh deploy-gameplay --hotfix); every new lock is played try by try again (one already issued is still accepted until it times out). Not as a live-only edit: every release and hotfix copies this file over the live one and keeps only admins, so a live edit lasts only until the next deploy.

gates._comment: Levered gates (Countess Frigga Hux, 17 Oct: she could not lock the lever of her own castle gate, and the gate did not visibly move for whoever pulled it). TWO FIXES, not one. The SYNC: the server keeps a door as isOpen and that reaches other clients, but a state is not an animation, so nothing played the gate for the player at the lever; gates.js plays it server-side to everyone in the cell, as ruinbuttons.js plays an expedition stair. Each name in open/close is sent BOTH ways - PlayAnimation (a behaviour graph) and PlayGamebryoAnimation (a NiControllerManager sequence) - because which one a mesh answers to is not knowable from its record, and Beyond Skyrim's stair answered only to the second (Telepe, 28 Sep). A name a mesh lacks plays nothing. The log line says which went out: read it to learn which call this gate wants, then the other can be dropped. The LOCK: a lever is an ACTI and housing claims DOORs and CONTs only, so a lever could never be locked and the gate's own lock was bypassed. A lever now answers to the gate's lock - while the gate is claimed AND locked, only whom its key opens may pull it. ROLLBACK: enabled false (hot reload; nothing is kept on a character or a reference).

elements._comment: What a hit's element does besides damage (Nate, 15 Oct, after a player report: frost damage landed but nothing was slowed). The server decides every hit and applies it as damage, so a spell's other effects never ran on the victim; elements.js gives them back. A PLAYER struck by a frost source is slowed speedMult for seconds (dboStatus kind chill, the packet the armour swap and the howl already use, so no client update is needed). An NPC cannot be slowed by the server (Papyrus reaches player actors only and the server is a relay for movement): its host's game has to do it, as npcmood.js does, so frost.npc.enabled stays false until a client carries dboNpcChill. minGapMs is the least time between two packets to one victim, so a fast caster does not send one a frame. The element is the game's own answer (the MGEF DATA resist value, as the blessings read it). ROLLBACK: enabled false (hot reload; a running slow ends on its own and on a relog).

Resistances, damage and the Orc's low-health rage go through the hit path; reductionCap caps Defense x blessing x race together (0.75 = never more than 75% off a hit). Off in beast forms, players only. Imperial goldBonus counts lease chests and bodies, camp chests and contract pay only. altmer.elementalWeakness is Nate's optional price (0 = off). nord.coldAreas: the Jerall Mountains around Bruma and the Pale Pass road. castHoldSeconds: no server-side regeneration (race, blessing, Ayleid well) is written for that long after the player's last cast, since the server's bars still predate the spell then (5 Oct: casts cost no magicka). channelHoldSeconds: after a concentration cast the hold lasts until the client's report moves the server's magicka, at most that long (8 Oct: a Flames channel past 3 s cost nothing).

mines._comment: Mines owned like property (mines.js, mines.json from tools/mines_build.py; Nate, 20 Oct: "allow all mines to be claimable. orc mines belong to the strongholds"). A mine is held by the housing claim on its way in: the hold's officials sell it at its door to a citizen (tenancy.js), it pays the weekly property tax in every hold, the Legion's tithe only on Cyrodiil's mines (economy.js titheProvinces), and it is no home (outside the one-building cap once the fork's housingSystem notHome ships). An Orc stronghold's mine is its clan's hall (guilds.js): never sold, the clan works it, its Chief and officers set its rules. The owner sets, from the panel at its door (property menu, Buy or rent) or /mine: who may mine (open, a faction and named people, named people only, closed) and a share of 0 to maxShare percent of what others mine, kept in ore in the mine's store for the owner to collect there. value + perVein for each vein is a mine's tax value until a Steward assesses it or the hold sells it (valueByMine { mine id: gold } overrides). A mine that is a lease dungeon and not in dungeons.exclude is a lair: not sold, and no clan holds it (leaseMinesForSale true sells them). Share payments are audited once per auditEveryMinutes per mine. ROLLBACK: enabled false, hot reload: every mine opens to all with no share and counts toward the cap again; clan mines stop being halls at the next reload; claims and mines-state.json stay.

skillRates._comment: What a skill's metered work is worth, per skill and per activity (skillrates.js; QoL feedback 4 Oct: mining, iron smithing and skinning too slow). The skill system meters each act through the repeat ring, the hourly bucket and the day's caps as before, then multiplies what it kept by the rate (0..5), as the playtesters' boost does: a rate moves a skill further for the same work, never lets more work through the bucket. rates.<skill> is a number, or { default, <kind>: n, craftByTier: [tier 1..5] } (kinds: craft, mine, chop, skin, kill, hit, hurt, cast, read, lock, prayer, eat, activate, award). A craft's tier is the recipe's DBO_Skill tier gate when it has one, else the highest materialTiers entry among its ingredients (editor ids); anything unlisted is tier 1 (iron, copper, leather, hide; iron, copper, corundum and tin ore). salvageLoop: a craft of a product the same character broke down at a station in the last windowMinutes is worth rate. Rates set by Nate 4 Oct (miner x2, skinner x1.5, iron-tier smithing x2.5, the loop guard on). Needs the fork's __dboSkillRate hook (masterySystem, fork mastery-skill-rates); hot reload.

rates._crafting: Nate, 11 Oct (economy scan): Alchemist and Cook crafts x2 (a week's top brewer made 2,901 potions for level 30), Woodcutter x1.5 (best character level 19).

materialTiers._ores: Ores by the Miner's tier order (skills.json miner.oreByTier, tier = index + 1), so only an iron-tier ore smelt is tier 1 (Nate, 4 Oct); copper, iron, corundum and tin are unlisted. Editor ids read from Skyrim.esm and BSAssets.esm.

skillRates._firstCraft: The first time a character makes an item it has never made in that skill (Discord 10 Oct; Nate: build it and turn it on with this update): rate times the XP for the first fullFor different items, then less and less (1 + (rate - 1) x fullFor / (n + 1)), never below 1. After the meter, like every rate: the hourly bucket and the day's caps still hold. Tempering earns none. skills: which crafts.

craftPerkTiers._comment: EbonySmithing at 3, not 4 (24 Oct, /bug #R4XE 'cant see the glacial crystal armor in the forge'): Glass, Glacial Crystal, Steel Plate and Ayleid (smithing.json tier 5, made from 60 points) ask for it, and rank 4 opens at 75, so a smith who could make them could not see them. The perk only shows a recipe; smithing.js still refuses a family above the smith's tier or without its technique. Keys are perk editor ids; a perk not listed stays locked (ArcaneBlacksmith only gates tempering enchanted gear and a few enchanted Immersive Armors sets, so it is left out). Re-read when this file changes; an empty perks turns it off. The same table is sent to each player (dboCraftPerks) so their own crafting menu shows the recipes; ArcaneBlacksmith is never granted. Each perk opens at the first rank whose points reach the earliest smithing.json family that needs it (Steel T2 15 pts, Orcish and Scaled T3 30, Glass T5 60; Barush #C9TM, an Orc at 34, saw no Orcish, 13 Oct), so the menu never hides what smithing.js allows; smithing.js still refuses a craft its tier or technique does not allow, materials kept. Needs fork craft-perk-tiers (C++ onCraftPerkRequired, masterySystem) and the client-craft-perks client.

citizenship._comment: Citizenship of the holds and the first Jarl vote (server/citizenship.js; Nate 13/14 Oct, ~/claude-nate-release/specs/citizenship-1014.md). Ships on. Citizenship gates buying property there (tenancy.js). noElection: holds with no vote (Bruma has a Count). election: starts by itself at threshold citizen accounts; registrationHours, then votingHours; counts hidden until the vote ends; those standing in a court on the ballot (and their other characters) do not vote. Each phase (registration, reopened, voting, revote, result) is told to the hold's online citizens, to each citizen character once at login during the phase (result: resultLoginDays), and posted to Discord channel announceChannel (#server-updates) pinging only the hold's discordRoles id; no channel or role: no post, logged. election.voterRules (Nate, 16 Oct: no Discord alts voting): an account votes, and counts toward threshold, only with a Discord account discordAgeDays old, playHours of play on playDays different days (playtime.js; a day counts after 15 minutes of play) and a character that was a citizen there citizenDays, each judged when the vote opens (play time is frozen then; during registration, against the time it is due to open). Only an election started with the rules on (stamped) uses them: one already running finishes under the old rules, and votes already cast stand. oneVotePerDevice (accounts the launcher's PC code links, backend device-ids.json, share one vote and count once) is OFF until the Privacy Policy names this use and players have re-accepted it; turning it on needs Jake (only a strict true does). No address is read or kept. A Lead GM strikes a vote with /strikevote <hold> <name or #TAG> <reason> (not when their account stands on that ballot), undoes it with /unstrikevote <hold> <name or #TAG>, and lists the struck votes with /electionreview; the voter is told, at once or at the next login. 0 turns a number off. Undo, first step: voterRules.enabled false and a hot reload: the rules go off, but struck votes stay struck and the three staff commands stay. Full undo: git revert and a hot reload. Never edit citizenship.json while the server runs (it is rewritten from memory). discordRoles: hold id -> Discord role id (create the roles by hand, the code never does). Rollback: enabled false (hot reload): no board tabs, no F3 tab, no purchase gate, no election tick; the rolls stay in citizenship.json. staffReleases (Jake, 16 Oct): staff revokes written here, for when no Lead GM is in game: [{ id, pid, actors?, zones?, by, why }]. At load and every hot reload each entry whose id is not yet in citizenship.json staffApplied takes every citizenship on the rolls from every character of profile pid (or the listed actors, hex; or only the listed zones) as the in-game revoke does, with no cooldown started or changed, withdraws the profile's pending requests, audits each removal and records the id with what it removed, so it never applies again (a re-join later stays; a new release needs a new id). A faction or court citizenship (auto) is not removed: the audit names it. A bad entry is skipped and logged. Undo: the character joins again or the ruler grants it; each removed hold (zone, since, how) is kept in the staffApplied record, to restore by hand in citizenship.json with the server stopped (the rolls live in memory). Removing an entry here changes nothing already applied. First elections (Nate, 17 Oct: waive the 7 day rule for every first election): voterRules.citizenDaysFirstElection (0) is the citizenship a hold's FIRST election asks for instead of citizenDays, for every hold, including the count toward threshold that starts it. A hold is past its first once it has seated a court by election (citizenship.json elected, written at the seat and kept when staff restart or resume delete the record; or a record with a result); every later election there, a staff restart included, asks for citizenDays. An election that staff cancel or that cancels itself before a seat keeps the hold at its first. voterRules.stampRunning (hold ids, only holds that elect; anything else is skipped and logged): at load and each hot reload a RUNNING election of that hold with no rules stamp and no vote cast is stamped in place with the rules, as its first unless the hold has seated a court before, keeping its courts, ballot and clock; once only, and audited. Undo: citizenDaysFirstElection 7 and stampRunning [] with a hot reload, but ONLY while no stamped or first election is running: done while one runs it refuses every voter who has not been a citizen for 7 days (in Riften now, all of them). A stamp cannot be taken off: the only undo for a stamped election is voterRules.enabled false, which turns every voter rule off in every hold. Follow-up: remove riften from stampRunning once its election is seated or cancelled.
